product_one_liner.value: Pack is an AI-powered workforce skills and development platform that maps employee skills, identifies capability gaps, and supports targeted development for organizations.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage has no public pricing link or pricing information; listed product material directs prospects to inquire.

named_customers.notes: The solutions page does not name customers or present customer case studies. The blog mentioning Allianz, PwC, and Nestlé discusses AI adoption generally, not Pack customers; therefore no customer names can be verified.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports company size of 11–50, which does not map precisely to the allowed bands. No supported narrower band found; this band is an estimate and should not be asserted.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn company listing gives Barcelona, Spain as its primary location. A news report refers to Barcelona as a key hub but does not establish formal HQ.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists founded in 2022; Invest in Spain also reports founding in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The accessible blog posts are HR/product and topical marketing content; no two engineering or technical build posts were found.

public_docs.notes: The homepage provides product information but no public documentation, developer portal, or help-center link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page did not list any current role postings.

model_provider.notes: No public statement identifying an AI model or model provider was located in product pages, blog/search results, or available security material.

compliance_certs.notes: The page explicitly says GDPR compliant. No other listed certification was evidenced.

last_funding.notes: Series A reported at €5.8 million in December 2025; converted approximately to USD at the period's exchange rate.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series A was announced in December 2025, within the 18-month window preceding 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Business Developer Representative posting is visible on the company site.

launched_6mo.notes: The current homepage has a launch message but no year/date attached; accessible blog history did not establish the newest launch-type announcement relative to the six-month cutoff.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated join/leave announcement or verifiable current full team page was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Business Developer Representative posting names use of HubSpot CRM.
